consequence.statement: The -tsdb.shipper.shared-store configuration option is no longer honoured; if its value does not match object_store for all tsdb periods, access to those indexes is lost.

assertion.statement: The CLI flag -tsdb.shipper.shared-store and its YAML equivalent tsdb.shipper.shared_store are removed in Loki 3.0.0 and are no longer honoured; if their value does not match object_store for all tsdb periods, index access is lost and manual migration is required.
